text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of feelings intersect at the 
Arima Kinen. Hishi Amazon shoulders the 
expectations of her juniors, while Mayano 
Top Gun aims to captivate everyone with 
her running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday looked forward to the 
matchup, while Narita Brian began to run, 
spurred on by her sister. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Sakura Laurel also 
prepared to step into battle, harboring 
powerful feelings in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing that admiration which has grown 
even stronger, I will stride toward future 
dreams with these legs of mine. Now, the 
Arima Kinen begins—
